kai: Quick question — where's the best dashboard for TTFT (p50/p95/p99) + tokens/sec per-model? We're seeing a small regression on the canary (quant-4x) and need to quickly verify whether it's throughput (tokens/sec) or first-token latency. Also: should we relax any alerts temporarily for the rollout? Thanks.

marie: Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/abcd/ttft-throughput (TTFT overview). Key panels: 'TTFT by model (p50/p95/p99)', 'Tokens/sec by model', 'Request rate by backend'. Quick PromQL snippets you can paste into Explore: 
```
# tokens/sec per model
sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_tokens_generated_total[1m]))

# TTFT p95 (use 5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(redwood_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])))

# TTFT p99
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, model) (rate(redwood_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
Set the dashboard range to last 5-15m to catch transient regressions. If you have low traffic on the canary, expand to 1h and look at raw request counts.

aj: For traces — use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.dev/search?service=inference&operation=serve.request . Filter by tag `model=<canary-model>` and sort by duration. Common hotspots: spans named `kv-cache:get`, `decoder`, or `aten::matmul` (for GPU op time). From Grafana you can click the trace link on the TTFT panel to jump straight to the matching traces.

sasha: Current alert is p95 TTFT > 250ms sustained for 5m. For this quant roll I'd suggest a temporary policy: bump p95 to 350ms (5m) and add a safety p99 > 1s (3m) that triggers an immediate manual review/rollback. For throughput, alert on relative drop: tokens/sec drops >30% vs 1h baseline for 3 consecutive minutes.

kai: Nice. Can someone patch the canary alert rule? I'll run a mix of traffic and compare traces. @devon can you add the runbook link to the Grafana dashboard (so oncall has steps)? Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/ttft-incidents

devon: On it — I'll open a grafana provisioning PR to add a small 'Runbook' panel and a direct Jaeger query link. ETA end of day.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Alert rule 'ttft-p95-canary' updated by devon in PR #4832 and deployed to staging.

marie: If you want the exact PromQL for a relative tokens/sec alert, use something like:
```
# baseline = 1h average tokens/sec per model
baseline = avg_over_time(sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_tokens_generated_total[1m]))[1h:])
# current = last 1m sample
current = sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_tokens_generated_total[1m]))
# alert condition (current < 0.7 * baseline)
(current / baseline) < 0.7
```
This avoids noise for tiny models. tweak the 0.7 threshold as needed.

kai: Thanks everyone — checking traces and metrics now, will post findings here. :thumbsup:
